## 2026 FIFA World Cup

### From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

The 2026 FIFA World Cup, branded as FIFA World Cup 26, was the 23rd FIFA World Cup, the quadrennial world championship for national football teams organized by FIFA. It was played across three countries: Canada, Mexico, and the United States from June 11 to July 19, 2026. With 48 teams competing, it was the first World Cup to use an expanded format. ## 2026 FIFA World Cup final

### From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

The 2026 FIFA World Cup final was the final match of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, which was the 23rd edition of the FIFA World Cup. The match was played on July 19, 2026, at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey, United States. The game involved Spain and Portugal with Spain winning 2-1 after extra time.
